key_insight: The paper shows that agentic AI can help formalize Shor’s algorithm family in Lean, producing machine-checked models for quantum attacks on RSA-2048 and P-256.
engineering_relevance: It provides a reproducible path for verifying quantum-cryptanalytic resource estimates, which is valuable for post-quantum security planning and formal methods workflows.
method: Agentic system searches sources, drafts Lean code, and repairs proofs under human review.
Formalizes quantum order-finding plus reversible circuits for modular and elliptic-curve arithmetic.
Derives logical resource estimates for RSA-2048 and P-256 from prior quantum cryptanalysis results.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a machine-checked Lean formalization of Shor-style algorithms and resource estimates for RSA-2048 and P-256, grounded in prior works from Quantum 5 and ASIACRYPT 2017.
watch_item: The results are formalized resource estimates rather than a new optimized attack, so practical feasibility still depends on circuit-level assumptions and implementation details.
paper_title: Building Shor's Algorithm in Lean: An Agentic Formalization of Quantum Attacks on RSA-2048 and P-256
